reserved_roster_note: SLURP-DEV-500-B-V1 is not opened here. Its own receipt declares carrier slurp and split_role 'dev', so every one of its identities is a member of the devel enumeration above, which these rosters are proved disjoint from id by id.
selection_rule: core.roster.freeze_roster, one shared random.Random(seed) advanced across the scenarios in ascending name order over each scenario's id-sorted recording pool. exclude_groups keys every recording by its utterance, so at most one recording per utterance is ever selected and an excluded utterance takes all of its recordings with it; the recording that lands is whichever of that utterance's recordings the shuffle reaches first, which is uniform over the utterance's recordings and imposes no headset / far-field quota. Draw order: fold A from the whole TRAIN pool, fold B from the pool minus fold A's utterances, exemplars from the pool minus both folds' utterances and restricted to utterances carrying at least one gold entity. Every TRAIN utterance this study has already touched -- the 739 named by the committed probe-sample receipts, speech-native dataset fragments, D1 supplements and g0 bindings -- is excluded from the candidate pool before any of the three draws.
